description: two storey rear and part side extension and internal alterations
decision_conditions: The proposed side and rear extension due to its bulk, scale and poor design would result in a dominant and visually intrusive extension which would result in an awkward relationship with the host property, having a harmful impact on the character and appearance of the existing dwelling and the visual amenity of the locality. The proposal would therefore be contrary to Policy 26 of the Local Plan 2021.

The proposed side and rear extension would due to its height, scale, design and proximity to shared boundaries result in a significant loss of outlook and an increased sense of enclosure resulting in an overbearing effect to the detriment of the amenity of the neighbouring occupiers. The proposal would therefore be contrary to Policy 7 and 26 of the Local Plan 2021.

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: Consideration was given to seeking amendments, but given conflict with adopted planning policy, notification of intended refusal and the reason(s) for it was given to Spaces Design, by email on 25/09/26.
